prompt.text:
Implement an atomic in-memory credit ledger in `solution.rs` using only the standard library. Expose `pub type AccountId = String`, `pub struct Ledger`, `pub struct Transfer { pub from: AccountId, pub to: AccountId, pub amount: u64 }`, and `pub enum LedgerError { EmptyAccount, DuplicateAccount, UnknownAccount, SameAccount, ZeroAmount, InsufficientFunds, Overflow }`. `Ledger::new(origin, supply)` creates exactly one account, permitting zero supply but rejecting an empty identifier. Provide `add_account`, `balance`, `total`, `apply`, and `apply_batch`. New accounts start at zero. Transfers require distinct known accounts and a positive amount. Arithmetic must be checked. A failed individual transfer must not mutate the ledger. A batch is ordered and all-or-nothing: return the first error and restore the complete pre-batch state. Empty batches succeed. Total supply must never change. Do not include `main`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
